thread:
maya: Quick sync on roles matrix + invite copy. Admins find compact rows hard to scan — needs an alternate that keeps clarity.
liam: Agreed. Idea: show primary permissions inline, hide secondary/advanced behind a chevron that expands. Keeps density but surfaces important bits.
sophia: Also raised by support: invite copy is ambiguous when SSO enforced. People think password step still exists.
jordan: Paste current copy?
maya: Current: `You can invite users. They will sign in with your org\u2019s SSO.` Admins read that as optional.
sam: Draft copy options to test:
A) "Invited users must sign in via your org\u2019s SSO. No password required."
B) "SSO required: new users will sign in with your SSO provider. They won't set a password."
C) "SSO enforced — use your identity provider to access the org."
liam: Lean B but trim if needed. "Won't set a password" is clearer than "No password required."
sophia: Add a small "Why SSO enforced?" link next to the copy that opens a tiny modal with an accessible explanation and steps.
jordan: Accessibility — keyboard users currently need many tabs to reach audit log and role details. We should add a compact skiplist above the table: "Jump to: Role details | Audit log | Invite flow". Visible to all and also accessible as skip links.
maya: Good. Eng-bot, any ARIA tips?
eng-bot: Ensure skip links are focusable, use aria-controls to point to section ids. Role row chevrons should have explicit aria-expanded and aria-controls.
sam: UX nit: chevrons need better labels: `Expand advanced permissions for <role>` not just `Toggle`. Also hit area should be at least 44px.
liam: For density settings, propose a two-option density toggle: "Comfortable" and "Condensed". Show a tiny preview next to the toggle so admins know what changes.
sophia: Tooltip for condensed mode: "Condensed saves vertical space, advanced perms hidden — useful for large orgs." Add an a11y hint that it changes focus order.
jordan: Audit log navigation suggestion: mini timeline scroller on the right to jump to date ranges. Must be keyboard operable and meet contrast ratios.
maya: Action items: 1) Sam to run microcopy A/B (favor B with slight trim). 2) Liam to prototype condensed row with inline primary perms + chevron. 3) Jordan to prototype skiplist and keyboardable audit scroller. 4) Sophia to draft SSO modal content and tooltip copy. 5) Eng to add aria states and migration flag checklist.
sam: I'll recruit 5 admins for quick usability tests tomorrow morning.
sophia: I'll add all a11y requirements to the PR description.
liam: 15-min sync after standup to align on components?
maya: Yep — ping at :bell:. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
